rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sharp tug or pulling at something, including pulling something out roughly.

example.english: I pluck the loose thread, and it comes right out.
example.traditional: 我一扯條鬆咗嘅線，成條就甩咗出嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ce2 tiu4 sung1 zo2 ge3 sin3 sing4 tiu4 zau6 lat1 zo2 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when something is pulled fully out or when feathers are removed from a bird.

example.english: You need to pluck all the feathers before cooking the chicken.
example.traditional: 煮雞之前要先拔晒啲毛。
example.jyutping: zyu2 gai1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 bat6 saai3 di1 mou4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for courage or fortitude.

example.english: He has the pluck to sing in front of so many people.
example.traditional: 佢有勇氣喺咁多人面前唱歌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 jung5 hei3 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1

rows.note: Use this for the guts or nerve to do something difficult or risky.

example.english: You really have the pluck to hike alone at night.
example.traditional: 你真係有膽量一個人夜晚行山。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 daam2 loeng6 jat1 go3 jan4 je6 maan5 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this when the pluck means persistence and determination over time.

example.english: It takes real pluck to finish this plan.
example.traditional: 要完成呢個計劃，真係要有毅力。
example.jyutping: jiu3 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jau5 ngai6 lik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for producing a note by pulling and releasing a string on an instrument.

example.english: I pluck one of the guitar strings with my finger, and it makes a clear note.
example.traditional: 我用手指彈結他其中一條弦，發出清脆嘅聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 zi2 daan6 git6 taa1 kei4 zung1 jat1 tiu4 jin4 faat3 ceot1 cing1 ceoi3 ge3 seng1
